note: Skill-selection corpus: what a user says, and which skill should answer. `triggers` must select the skill, `nearMisses` must select some other skill named in `expected`. Re-run `node tests/skill-routing/run.mjs --print-prompt`, give the prompt to a model, and score the reply with `--decisions <file>`. The corpus is only as good as the descriptions it tests: a case whose phrase cannot be found in the visible catalog budget is a routing defect, and the gate says so.
